notes.title: New trading cards, profile backgrounds and more released!
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

We're happy to be adding Steam community items for Sherlock Holmes and The Hound of The Baskervilles (took us long enough, yup:) 

So we've recently released the following:
- a badge
- 6 trading cards
- 3 profile backgrounds
- 6 emoticons

We hope they'll be a nice addition to your collection and showcase!

Take care,
Your Frogwares Team

notes.title: Сompatibility Patch (Part 2 of 2) released!
notes.content:
Hello again, fellow sleuths!

We're releasing the long-awaited second part of the compatibility patch.

This patch fixes common startup and save issues of our older games running on Windows 10. 

We hope you can continue enjoying our previous games to the fullest with these new fixes.

Take care!
Frogwares team

tags.bug: This patch fixes common startup and save issues of our older games running on Windows 10.

notes.title: Compatibility Patch (Part 1 of 2) released!
notes.content:
Hey there, detectives!

Get ready to welcome a long-requested compatibility patch! 

This patch switches pre-requisite redistributables to common redistributables for our backcatalog games.

Essentially, this is part one of a two-part patch that is needed to allow us to address compatibility issues of our older games with modern PCs.

Second patch, actually fixing the compatibility issues, is coming in early May 2021.

Enjoy!
Frogwares team
